article.title: Power of Central Government or Board to condone delays in obtaining approval.
article.content: Where, under any provision of this Act, the approval of the Central Government or the Board is required to be obtained before a specified date, it shall be open to the Central Government or, as the case may be, the Board to condone, for sufficient cause, any delay in obtaining such approval.
article.html:
293BPower of Central Government or Board to condone delays in obtaining approval.

Section 293B · Chapter XXIII · page 1077 of the Act

Where, under any provision of this Act, the approval of the Central Government or the Board is required to be obtained before a specified date, it shall be open to the Central Government or, as the case may be, the Board to condone, for sufficient cause, any delay in obtaining such approval.
